correctness.rationale: For a finite connected simple bicyclic base with exactly E=V+1, zero-diagonal unit-modulus Hermitian gains and apex couplings gauged to 1, the order-four apex survival coefficient is N²/3+||Q1||²/12; matching cos²(sqrt(N)t) for all t forces Q1=0. Conversely Q1=0 makes the apex and uniform base vector a 2x2 invariant subspace, proving both exact return and uniform base probability for all times. Leaf rows cannot cancel. Handshaking sum(deg-2)=2 reduces leafless bases to theta, figure-eight and barbell; at each degree-two path vertex gains alternate t,-conj(t). An equilateral unit-gain triple gives theta two phase circles for uniform parities or exactly four points for mixed parities. A figure-eight admits imaginary circulation on both cycles. Even cycle lobes in barbells produce zero root contribution and cannot cancel their unit bridge; odd-odd lobes give 2*2*2=8 assignments. Phase counts concern labelled/oriented bases and fixed apex gauge, not gauge-equivalence classes. Independently formed theta rows for lengths (2,2,2), (1,2,2), (1,3,2) and verified residuals below 4e-16; inspected the finite checker for 1,145 constructed cones, 28 local obstructions and apex moments through order twelve. Those finite checks alone do not prove the universal theorem.
